urls.title: File links
urls.description: Direct links to PDF files or images (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, GIF, BMP), one per line. Files are downloaded only where the site's robots.txt allows it; for other files (for example Google Drive or Dropbox, which don't allow automated downloads), download the file and upload it below.

file.title: Upload a file
file.description: Or upload one PDF or image from your computer.

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.description: PDF pages usually carry their own text, which is read exactly and fast. Scanned pages are images, so they need OCR. Auto runs OCR only on pages with almost no text. Images are always read with OCR.

languages.title: OCR languages
languages.description: The languages of the scanned text. Pick all languages that appear, for example English and Thai; fewer languages read faster and more accurately.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Only these pages of each PDF, for example 1-3, 5, 10-. Empty: all pages.

includeMarkdown.title: Markdown
includeMarkdown.description: Add the text as Markdown, with a section per page, ready for LLMs and notes.

includePages.title: Text of each page
includePages.description: Add a list of pages with their text, the method (text layer or OCR) and the OCR confidence.

includeChunks.title: Chunks for RAG
includeChunks.description: Add the text cut into chunks of about Chunk size characters at paragraph ends, each with its page numbers, ready for a vector database.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: About this many characters per chunk.

datasetId.title: Links from a dataset
datasetId.description: The ID of a dataset (for example the results of another Actor) whose items hold file links. Their links are read too.

datasetField.title: Dataset link field
datasetField.description: The field of the dataset items that holds the link (or a list of links).

pdfPassword.title: PDF password
pdfPassword.description: For password-protected PDFs. The same password is used for every file.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: Max pages per document
maxPagesPerDocument.description: At most this many pages of each PDF are read.

minTextChars.title: Minimum text per page
minTextChars.description: With OCR on Auto, a page with fewer letters and digits than this in its text layer is treated as a scan.

ocrDpi.title: OCR resolution (DPI)
ocrDpi.description: Scanned PDF pages are turned into images at this resolution for OCR. 300 suits most documents; raise it for very small print.
